name: nan-model-functions-at-blend-and-rounding-edges-under-fast-math
rationale: nan_functions_fast (the default fast math) at the NaN model's edges (DESIGN D293): lane i reads (a, b, t) and writes nan_functions' 36 words. Lanes: mix(a, b, t) at t = 0 and t = 1, at infinite and signed-zero endpoints and blend factors, and on lanes chosen so that the candidate compositions of the blend (fma(t, b, fma(-t, a, a)), its unfused variants, a * (1 - t) + b * t, and a + t * (b - a)) answer differently; then round and fract operands at signed zeros, small negatives, ties, and 2^23 neighbours. Every operand is loaded from a buffer; the output is pre-filled with 0xAB.

name: nan-model-functions-of-nan-operands-under-fast-math
rationale: nan_functions' program and lanes compiled with the default fast math (the air.fast_* functions). A NaN or infinite operand is undefined under fast math; this records what Metal answers. Compiled without fast math unless named; every operand is loaded from a buffer, so nothing folds but what the AIR shows. NaN operands: quiet and signaling of either sign with payloads 0, 1, 2, 0x1000, 0x155555, 0x2aaaaa, 0x3ffffe, 0x3fffff. The output is pre-filled with 0xAB.

name: pack-one-bitfield-union-word
rationale: The one output element is a union of a float and a 10:11:11 bitfield, whose air.struct_type_info spells the three fields at byte offsets 0, 1 and 2 with the four-byte size of the storage word they share. The single invocation divides packed_uint3 (85, 182, 73) by the exact divisor one, so the clamp to [0, 255] passes all three through, and each lane's product with its packing constant sits within 0.004 of a whole number, so air.fast_round is unambiguous: 341, 1461 and 586 pack to 0x4956D555 with an alternating low field and two distinct upper fields, so a lost mask, a wrong shift, or a swapped lane changes the bytes.

name: coverage-loop-records-each-sample-at-2x
rationale: A fragment function that reads [[sample_mask]] and [[sample_id]] and writes memory, in a pass without attachments (the oracle's 1x1) at 2 samples, drawn by the generated full-screen triangle: Metal runs it once per covered sample, each run reading the pixel's coverage (DESIGN D341). Word s ORs the run's coverage | 0x100, word 16 + s counts the runs: 0x103 and 1 for samples 0 and 1, 0 elsewhere.

name: coverage-loop-records-each-sample-at-4x
rationale: The same function at 4 samples. Apple's rasterizer splits the clipped full-screen triangle's pixel into pieces whose runs read their piece's coverage (DESIGN D341 item 6): samples 0 and 1 read 0x3, samples 2 and 3 read 0xc, each run once. A Vulkan device reads the whole coverage, 0xf: an answer gap (clipped_primitive_split), open.

name: coverage-loop-sample-varying-at-2x
rationale: A [[sample_perspective]] float2 varying (the companion's uv = 2a) read at each run's sample beside the coverage, at 2 samples: sample 0 at (0.75, 0.75) reads uv (0.75, 0.25), sample 1 at (0.25, 0.25) reads (0.25, 0.75); word s ORs round(uv * 16) (x in bits 0-7, y in 8-15), the coverage in bits 16-23, and bit 24.

name: coverage-loop-union-of-runs-at-2x
rationale: What any split leaves alone, at 2 samples: the union of the coverages the runs read (0x3), the union of their samples (0x3), the runs (2), and whether a run's sample was outside its coverage (0).

name: coverage-loop-union-of-runs-at-4x
rationale: What any split leaves alone, at 4 samples, where Apple's rasterizer splits the pixel (DESIGN D341 item 6): the union of the coverages the runs read (0xf), the union of their samples (0xf), the runs (4), and whether a run's sample was outside its coverage (0).

name: explicit-cube-gradient-combination-table
rationale: A second probe of the level of detail an explicit cube gradient selects (D283 family B), driven by a table, in a kernel: texture 0 is a cube and texture 1 a cube array of 2 cubes, rgba16_float 4x4, texel (x, y) of slice s holding 1 + x + 4y + 16s in every channel; the constexpr sampler minifies linearly and magnifies nearest over one level, so a sample is the nearest texel when the device's level of detail is at most 0 and the bilinear blend when above. Buffer 0 holds the configuration count C = 90 (in the bits of in[0].x), then per configuration a direction and dP/dx and dP/dy, then 81 magnitudes 2^(j/16), j = -40..40 (as float). Lane i of 7290 takes configuration i % C and scales both gradients by magnitude i / C; it writes the cube's and the cube array's (layer 1) red channels to out[i] of buffer 1 (float2 elements, pre-filled with 0xAB). The 15 configurations per face (with major axis a, the normal axis a, the kept tangent (a + 2) mod 3, and the tangent (a + 1) mod 3 the first probe found ignored) combine the counted axes in one gradient (1:1, 1:-1, 1:0.5), add the ignored axis, split the counted axes between dP/dx and dP/dy (1:1, 1:0.5), scale the direction to |major axis| 2 and 0.5, and move it near the face edge; where each sweep turns from the texel to the blend separates how the device combines components. Every footprint lies inside one face. The AIR has no loop.

name: explicit-cube-gradient-component-combination-by-ratio
rationale: A fourth probe of the level of detail an explicit cube gradient selects (D283 family B), on the second probe's fixture: texture 0 is a cube and texture 1 a cube array of 2 cubes, rgba16_float 4x4, texel (x, y) of slice s holding 1 + x + 4y + 16s in every channel, sampled through a sampler that minifies linearly and magnifies nearest over one level. Buffer 0 holds the configuration count C = 81, then per configuration a direction and dP/dx and dP/dy, then 121 magnitudes 0.5 (1 + k / 2000), k = -50..70 (a twentieth-of-a-percent grid from 2.5% below 0.5 to 3.5% above). Every configuration samples the +Z face at texel (1, 2), a quarter texel past its centre, with a unit dP/dx whose two counted components (the face normal z and the tangent y) have the ratio r of the smaller to the larger: r = k / 64, k = 0..64, with the normal the larger, and r = k / 16, k = 0..15, with the tangent the larger. A rule that is the Euclidean length of the two components turns from the texel to the blend at magnitude 0.5 in every configuration; where each sweep turns measures Apple's combination as a function of r to a twentieth of a percent. Lane i of 9801 takes configuration i % C and magnitude i / C and writes the cube's and the cube array's (layer 1) red channels to out[i] of buffer 1 (float2 elements, pre-filled with 0xAB). The AIR has no loop.

name: explicit-cube-gradient-component-combination-fine
rationale: A third probe of the level of detail an explicit cube gradient selects (D283 family B), on the second probe's fixture: texture 0 is a cube and texture 1 a cube array of 2 cubes, rgba16_float 4x4, texel (x, y) of slice s holding 1 + x + 4y + 16s in every channel, sampled through a sampler that minifies linearly and magnifies nearest over one level. Buffer 0 holds the configuration count C = 138, then per configuration a direction and dP/dx and dP/dy, then 51 magnitudes 0.5 (1 + (k + 1/2) / 500), k = -25..25 (a fifth-of-a-percent grid around 0.5 that never lands on it). The 23 configurations per face put a unit dP/dx at angle 0, 5, .., 90 degrees between the face normal and the tangent (a + 2) mod 3 the first probe found counted (cosine on the normal), and at 0 and 45 degrees with the direction and the gradient both scaled by 2 and by 0.5. A footprint rule that is the length of the two components over |major axis| turns from the texel to the blend at magnitude 0.5 in every configuration; where each sweep turns measures the rule to a fifth of a percent. Lane i of 7038 takes configuration i % C and magnitude i / C and writes the cube's and the cube array's (layer 1) red channels to out[i] of buffer 1 (float2 elements, pre-filled with 0xAB). The AIR has no loop.

name: explicit-cube-gradient-turning-points-and-threshold
rationale: A fifth probe of the level of detail an explicit cube gradient selects (D283 family B, D283.5): the turning points of the two-component rule the fourth probe found, F = 2 L(|g_a|, |g_b|) / |m_a| with L(M, m) = max(M + 3/16 m, 49/64 M + 21/32 m) (M and m the larger and smaller of the normal and the counted tangent), and its threshold, at f32 ulp spacing, on the second probe's fixture: texture 0 is a cube and texture 1 a cube array of 2 cubes, rgba16_float 4x4, texel (x, y) of slice s holding 1 + x + 4y + 16s in every channel, sampled through a sampler that minifies linearly and magnifies nearest over one level. Buffer 0 holds the configuration count C = 64, then per configuration a direction and dP/dx and dP/dy, then 161 multipliers 1 + k 2^-23, k = -128..32. Each configuration's gradient is prescaled so that the rule puts F exactly at 1 + 3/2048 at multiplier 1, so the multipliers step F by about one f32 ulp across the whole interval the earlier probes left for the threshold. The configurations: one component (10: both axes, faces +Z, +X, -Y, -Z, major axes 1, 3, 5, 7, and 3/4), the ratio r of the smaller component to the larger at k / 32, k = 1..32, with the normal the larger (32) and k / 8, k = 1..7, with the tangent the larger (7), the corner r = 1/2 at +-1/64 and +-1/1024 (4), and r = 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1 with a major axis of 3 (4), on dP/dy (2), on face -X (3), and with a negative tangent (2). Every configuration samples texel (1, 2) of its face, a quarter texel past its centre. Lane i of 10304 takes configuration i % C and multiplier i / C and writes the cube's and the cube array's (layer 1) red channels to out[i] of buffer 1 (float2 elements, pre-filled with 0xAB). The AIR has no loop.

name: index-a-merged-pointer-at-a-constant-element
rationale: A device pointer merged across TWO DESCRIPTORS and then indexed at a CONSTANT element index. Logical SPIR-V has no pointer value that can be either descriptor, so the merge becomes a PhysicalStorageBuffer64 device address and every index off it has to be taken from that ADDRESS. The translator did that only when the index was DYNAMIC; a constant index fell through to a plain retype, which left an OpAccessChain descending into a merged pointer whose pointee is a byte -- not a composite -- and the whole module was refused with 'owned InBoundsAccessChain violates its access-chain contract: index 0 descends into %N (TypeInt 8 0), which is not a composite type'. This case is that shape, and it does not translate at all before the fix. a holds 100+i and b holds 200+i, so the descriptor each lane's merge chose is legible in the word itself. TWO different constant indices are read (1 and 3), so an index folded to zero or dropped shows up as 100/200 or as the wrong row, and a third row reads the same merge at a DYNAMIC index as the control that already worked. Expected: out[0..7]=101 101 101 101 201 201 201 201, out[8..15]=103 103 103 103 203 203 203 203, out[16..23]=100 101 102 103 204 205 206 207. Every value is an exact small integer.

name: reduce-thirty-two-points-to-a-bounding-box-minimum
rationale: Metal ground truth for air.simd_shuffle_down.v3f32 (32 case-less sources). kUseSimdgroup is set true, which is what selects the simdgroup reduction over the threadgroup-memory one; kPackFormatConstant is zero, the packed_float3 arm, so the 384-byte positions buffer is 32 points at stride twelve. vertexCount is 32 and the dispatch is one 32-thread threadgroup, so ceil(32/32) = 1 point per thread and every lane contributes exactly one point -- the answer is the whole simdgroup shuffle-down tree, and a reduction that lost any lane or used a wrong offset lands somewhere else. Point i is (i+1, 100-i, i odd ? -i : i), so the three minima come from three DIFFERENT lanes: x from lane 0, y from lane 31, z from lane 31 on the odd branch. Expected float3(1, 69, -31), all small exact integers, and fmin over exact floats is exact and order-independent, so the fast-math reassociation this module permits cannot move it. Only the first twelve bytes are compared: the float3 slots are sixteen bytes and the shader writes twelve, so the padding is never stored by either side.
